headline: Public hearings on liquor license applications for 211 Worthington Street and 1655 Boston Road.
summary: Yaadstop Bar & Grill, LLC and Beyond Oishii, Inc. each seek a new all-alcoholic liquor license. The agenda also lists non-subdivision plans and board elections.
